title: MarketItem
description: Unified record every connector normalises into. Frozen contract between ingestion, backend, AI and frontend: field names are snake_case here even though the older endpoints use camelCase. Timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC, dates always with a time part.

id.description: Stable id within its source, e.g. '2026-11:inserate:aktiv'. Unique per source.

category.description: Primary category of the item, used for filtering (A-E).

categories.description: All categories the source feeds. category must be one of them.

title.description: Short, human readable headline as shown in the UI.

summary.description: One to three sentences of plain text, HTML already stripped.

metrics.description: Numeric values that belong to this record. The key names the meaning, e.g. {"anzahl": 41, "basis": null}.

tags.description: Free-form tags and skills, e.g. ["inserate", "role:IT Support"].

region.description: Canton code (ZH, BE, ...) when the record mentions a target city; null when it cannot be mapped to a canton.

source_name.description: Shown next to every number so the origin is always visible.

source_url.description: Link to the original data of this source (provenance).

url.description: Permalink of this single record; null for aggregate records that have none.

published_at.description: When the data was published (period start for monthly/ yearly figures), null if unknown.

fetched_at.description: When the connector retrieved the data. Drives the 'Last updated' badge.

category.description: A = demand/ job market, B = skills, C = employers, D = population/ permits, E = policy/ regulation.
